name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
January 24, 2012
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Howard Amend, Rotary Club of Vista
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring Wednesday, January 25, 2012, "Gregory Rafail Day" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Presentation of Certificates of Appreciation for Adopt-a-Block volunteers.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
False Alarm Tracking Services Agreement
C4.
Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control Grant (CC)
C5.
Investment Advisory Committee Revisions and Investment Policy Re-Adoption (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending City Council Resolution No. 95-19 establishing an Investment Advisory Committee; and
2.
Re-adopt City Council Policy 700-07, Investment of City Funds.
C6.
Maryland Drive Street Improvements Change Order (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving Change Order No. 1 with Dick Miller, Inc for additional sewer improvements; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the FY 2011/12 Capital Improvement Program Budget.
C7.
Park Landscape Maintenance Agreement (CC)
C8.
Activation of Housing Authority (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , activating the Housing Authority of the City of Vista.
2.
Introduce and Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2012- , an urgency ordinance providing that Community Development Commission of the City of Vista shall operate the Housing Authority of the City of Vista as permitted by the California Health and Safety Code.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , designating the Housing Authority of the City of Vista as the successor housing agency pursuant to Health and Safety Code section 34176.
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving a Cooperation Agreement with the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista in connection with housing functions.
5.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2012- , approving a Cooperation Agreement with the City of Vista in connection with housing functions.
C9.
Amended Enforceable Obligation Payment Schedule (CDC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Conduit Financing for Vista Terrace Apartments (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act Public Hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the issuance of tax-exempt obligations and directing certain actions.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
